conbody.p: You can set the brightness (day/night) and contrast of the camera image in Display settings.

li.p: Depending on your vehicle’s features and specifications, the settings menu may not be available.
The horizontal Parking Guidance lines displayed on the Surround View Monitor indicate distances from your vehicle of 0.5 m (20 in), 1 m (40 in), and 2.3 m (91 in).
The horizontal scale displayed by Top View Parking Lines indicates the tailgate opening distances and 2 m (79 in) from your vehicle.
